protocol.purpose: Frozen full fine-grid controls following reproduced iteration-cap failure; no parameter calibration

analysis_protocol.metrics: Retain every completed/failed/partial outcome. Reconstruct final/partial energy/water against sources; report land/interior rainfall, evaporation, soil water and temperature, spatialtimestep differences. Compare completed21-level runs against oldnine-level900/450 andsix-level900 archives. No minimum rainfall gain or unanimity gate.
analysis_protocol.interpretation: Larger maximum work allowance does not change the converged closure target or its stopping tolerance. Captured India target needed176 sweeps and caps256/512/1024 werebyteexact; this does not establish1024 sufficient for every new state. All physical inputs and unknown piecewiseconstant subcell reconstruction remain unchanged.
analysis_protocol.counts: Six new actual integrations ifallstart, after103starts/95completions/eight failures includingoneexpectedreplay rejection. Ifallfinish then109starts/101completions/eight retainedfailures; reportactualcounts. Legacy1934/1929 unchanged.
analysis_protocol.observations: Record every coupled call, including failed attempts, with wall time and successful target convergence/sweep counts. No dropped timing sample, timing gate or repeated-timing confidence claim. Metadata does not change physical arithmetic.

protocol.failure: Do not raise cap, loosen tolerance, change parameters or replace cases after outcomes. Preserve every failure and partial state. No physical adoption, monthly skill or recalibration.

receipt.scope: Declared lower-cell refinement, same pressure lids and Earth-like parameters. First24h transient rain and timestep sensitivity only. Static conversion rain excluded from run rainfall. Four-way grid has900/450s controls; sixteen-way grid has900s only, no local timestep convergence claim. Retain all failures/partials.

protocol.purpose: Fixed24h fine-grid controls with solver workcap1024; unchanged physical closure and neutral tolerance
protocol.initial: Frozen conservative piecewise-constant pressure refinement of preceding wet50kg/m² initial state. Total gas/surface/kinetic energy, columnwater and momentum preserved; target-pressure conversion rain/H returned beforetime0, not counted as runrain. No extra wind projection or inferred subcell lapse.

omitted_upper.description: Fixed exterior isothermal emitting slab above380hPa. T from initial6K/km source profile at p_top/2 with200K floor; dry tau uses declared dry opacity times omitted pressure mass. DownwardLW=sigma*T^4*(1-exp(-tau_above)). This is an externally maintained partial-column boundary, NOT TOA.

protocol.forcing: Daily-mean Earth-orbit solar at evolving source day, prescribed25% outside reflection and drySW attenuation through omitted upper air; greyLW depth=kappa_dry*Md+.025*W, updates with actual vapor. Neutral loglaw at explicit initial pressure-derived reference height; signed dew/evap; finite liquid/heat reservoir. No forced temperature restoration.
protocol.paired_control: Same accepted fast phase root, physics, source fields, forcing and transport body. Reference calls original spsolve per quantity; candidate shares a factor only for exactly identical CSC shape/index/value arrays within one advance. Every linear solve still receives its own RHS and actual face checks.
protocol.approximation: Exploratory grey optical depths and neutral roughness are declared choices, not measured or Earth-fitted opacities. No clouds/spectral scattering, surface stability/gusts, ice/runoff/deep heating, terrain or nonlinear momentum. Daily-mean rather than diurnal forcing. Partial upper boundary and lateral fields held externally.
protocol.energy_water: All actual vapor enthalpy/sensible exchange debited from finite surface; phase/dynamic rain returns mass and actual liquidH exactly once and changes surface heat capacity. Total gas+kinetic+surface E changes only by declared radiation/top/lateral power; total atmospheric+surfacewater changes only by lateral vapor transport.
protocol.failure: Reject exhausted surface/airwater or out-of-domain temperatures; preserve all failures/partials; no parameter changes, clipped sources, replacement cases or adaptive post-outcome tuning.
protocol.counts: Two new actual Earth-input integrations; retain original64-sweep failures and every new outcome. No legacy benchmarks.

run.scope: 24h forced/unforced Earth-input smoke, fixed declared grey/neutral flux assumptions and finite surface water/energy. Partial380hPa top has explicit exterior solar/LW, not TOA. No observed data, terrain/nonlinear momentum, monthly calibration or adoption.
